title: Product Rule with Sine and Cosine
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar

steps.title: Differentiate Each Group Using Product Rule
steps.mathExpression: \frac{d}{dx}[x^2 \sin x] = 2x\sin x + x^2\cos x; \quad \frac{d}{dx}[2x\cos x] = 2\cos x - 2x\sin x; \quad \frac{d}{dx}[-2\sin x] = -2\cos x

steps.title: Combine and Cancel Terms
steps.mathExpression: (2x\sin x + x^2\cos x) + (2\cos x - 2x\sin x) - 2\cos x = x^2\cos x
steps.explanation: Notice that 2x*sin(x) cancels with -2x*sin(x), and 2*cos(x) cancels with -2*cos(x).
steps.why: Algebraic cancellation yields a single term.
